title: Create a "Zedu Integration" Wishlist Survey
description: Zedu might need to integrate with tools like Zoom, Google Classroom, or GitHub. Write a survey/questionnaire that Zedu can send to current bootcamp users asking which tools they'd want Zedu to integrate with next.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: Integration-Led SEO Content Strategy
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Instead of just a survey, build a series of "Zedu + [Tool]" landing pages (e.g., "Zedu for Zoom Users"). Each page targets the specific pain point of using that tool for cohorts (e.g., Zoom s silos information) and shows how Zedu integrates or improves the workflow. This captures search traffic from users of existing tools and converts them based on identified integration needs.
